name: Catherine E. Heffernan
bioAdditions: FamilySearch (LHHH-W5T) gives her birth as 2 Aug 1870 at Plymouth, citing seven attached records (S1); the 1880 census lists her as "Catheren Heferon" in her father's household.

conflicts.assessment: The day and month (August) agree with Dwyer; the year differs by one. Her parents married 1 Sep 1868, so either is possible. Her 1947 death certificate (#35591) should give the date.
